purpose: Record an independent visual source-image review of the official Kirinyaga Central Form 34B final TOTAL row, read directly from the official IEBC portal PDF.

sample.review_context_note: Rendered directly from the freshly downloaded, sha256-verified official IEBC Form 34B PDF, cropped around the TOTAL row for digit-level confirmation at 500 DPI. The portal only served this PDF after a home-page + set-election (2022 General Election, election id 5) session handshake.

review.reviewed_by: Claude Sonnet 5 (Anthropic), acting as an independent Kenya Data Atlas contributor agent
review.independence_note: The official Form 34B PDF was downloaded fresh directly from forms.iebc.or.ke in this session, its sha256 was computed from the downloaded bytes, and the TOTAL row integers were read directly from the rendered page image. No OCR, machine-candidate pipeline, or prior extraction artifact was used or consulted before recording these values. Constituency identity (KIRINYAGA CENTRAL, code 103) was read from the visible 'CON 103' banner marker printed on the page before this row was accepted.

same_row_valid_vote_reconciliation.method: Independent visual read of the four presidential candidate total cells on the same final TOTAL row.

row_reconciliation.governed_p23_registered_voters_source: KDA-VOTERS-CON-103-2022 (data/indicators/registry/observations.json), exact sum of official IEBC child ward rows

note: Total Valid Votes, Rejected Ballots and the four candidate cells are individually clear and internally reconcile exactly on the printed TOTAL row (candidate sum 58,048 = printed Total Valid Votes). However, the row's own printed Registered Voters figure (82,111) does not exactly match the separately governed P23 registered-voter denominator for this constituency (82,049). The printed Form 34B total includes one special-facility polling station with a non-ward code ('049292145104701 KERUGOYA PRISON - 01', registered 62) on the same TOTAL row, exactly explaining the observed delta of 62. This matches the recurring genuine prison/national-facility denominator gap documented elsewhere in this Atlas (e.g. Makueni, Nyeri Town, Maragwa) rather than a transcription error. Per the extraction contract's exact-reconciliation requirement for registered_voters (mismatch_treatment: unresolved), this row is preserved unresolved and no turnout observation may be promoted from this evidence until the denominator conflict is independently reconciled by the governed P23 registered-voters denominator process.
